user.title: Add to Floor Heating
user.description: Add a room, or the house Master that sends the mode (Occupied/Unoccupied/Frost/Off) to all rooms. There can be only one Master.

menu_options.pump_group: Add a pump group (pump control + shunt advice)

room.title: Add a room to the floor heating
room.description: Every room gets its own controller. Add the integration again for each room.

data.name: Room name (e.g. Living room)
data.room_sensor: Room temperature sensor - leave empty if the room has none (floor only)

master.title: Master
master.description: The house mode is sent to all rooms, like in IHC. The outdoor sensor is only used if a room has outdoor compensation (ke) above 0.

data.name: Name
data.weather_entity: Weather entity for forecast and sun (optional)

pump_group.title: Pump group
pump_group.description: Name, pump feedback and the shunt sensor. Rooms choose their own group in their settings (Pump group), so you never pick the same thing twice.

data.name: Name (e.g. Technical room or Basement)
data.pump_switches: Switches that start the pump (IHC pump control)

init.title: Room settings
init.description: When the window is open the output is frozen, so nothing is regulated on the room temperature. Only "Kun Gulv" (floor only) keeps regulating.

data.window_sensor: Window and door contacts (optional, empty = no window rule)
data.max_floor_temp: Max floor temperature (°C) - heating stops above this
data.valve_exercise_days: Valve exercise: open the valve if it has not been open for this many days (0 = off)
data.stale_hours: A sensor without updates for this many hours counts as missing (0 = off)
data.outdoor_ke: Outdoor compensation ke (% output per degree between target and outdoor, 0 = off)
data.solar_gain: Solar gain ks (% output subtracted at full sun, 0 = off)
data.linked_rooms: Linked rooms (same air space, optional): room temperatures are averaged and the room setpoint follows. Set it in both rooms
data.link_weight: Weight in the shared average (e.g. room m², only used with linked rooms)
data.pump_group: Pump group (which pump/shunt the room belongs to)
data.pump_switch: Pump switch for the room (IHC pump control; suggested from the actuator name)
data.summer_stop: Summer stop also applies to this room (the limit is set on the Master)
data.humidity_sensor: Humidity sensor for mould risk warnings (optional, needs an outdoor temperature on the Master)
data.backup_room_sensor: Backup room sensor (optional): takes over if the room sensor drops out
data.silent_hours: Alarm if a wireless battery sensor is silent for this many hours (no value changed; 0 = off)

master_options.title: Master
master_options.description: Outdoor sensor and/or weather entity for outdoor compensation (ke) and solar gain (ks). Which source the rooms use is chosen with the Master's 'Ude Kilde'. Notifications (review, hunting rooms, proposals, alarms and shunt advice) are sent as chosen at the bottom. The 'Send Testbesked' button tries it out.

data.weather_entity: Weather entity for forecast and sun (optional)
data.forecast_hours: Forecast: average over this many hours ahead
data.review_days: Suggest the first review of the settings after this many days of running
data.allow_ai_changes: Allow an AI to change settings directly (default: no - it can only propose, and you press Apply Proposal)
data.notify_in_ha: Show messages as a notification in HA
data.notify_mobiles: Also push messages to these phones (optional)

pump_options.title: Pump group
pump_options.description: Rooms choose the group in their own settings. The pump starts on heat demand and stops after the run-on delay. If idle for the set number of days it is exercised at 03:00 for 5 minutes. The room and switch fields are only for special cases.

data.pump_stop_minutes: Run-on: minutes after the last valve closed before the pump stops
data.pump_motion_days: Exercise: days without running before the pump is exercised (0 = off)
